fair_value_reason: Clean NTM non-GAAP EPS at Oct 2027 of ~$4.30 (clean Q3 base $0.77; ~25% revenue growth; ~40% incremental margin; partial Farmers Branch absorption from early 2028) x 30x = $129, plus ~$5 of net cash per share ($334M at 6/27/26 + FCF, over ~80M diluted shares) = ~$134. I trim to $133 for SBC (~$0.35/share after tax a year treated as free in non-GAAP EPS) and for FCF cross-checks of $104-128 after correcting agent_3's SBC double count. This is below my round-1 $135 and above the round-2 mean of $131.6, which stacks Technoprobe haircuts on both growth and multiple.

thesis_triggers.event: $90 is just under the early-September low ($92), about 40% below the $149.15 close, and about 20-21x clean NTM EPS of ~$4.30 (plus ~$5 of cash). Getting there would most likely require a fundamental break: an HBM/DRAM order cut (SK hynix 24.3% of Q2 revenue; DRAM already flat q/q), logic share loss to Technoprobe beyond what is priced in, the Nvidia second source failing to appear, or underlying GM settling below ~51% as Farmers Branch costs reach COGS. Agents range from $85 to $92 (mean $89.4); I keep $90.

supervisor_summary: After round 2 the five forecasters agree tightly ($128-136 fair value; P(close >= $148 on 2027-10-02) about 0.46), but most of that agreement comes from adopting my round-1 clean-EPS base. That base is now confirmed by the CFO's remarks on the Q2 call (~51% baseline GM; the Q3 guide includes $7-9M of IEEPA refunds), so it is one checked fact, not five. New primary checks cut both ways. Farmers Branch start-up costs are already in non-GAAP results and turn accretive from early 2028, which slightly supports EPS. DRAM/HBM revenue was flat quarter on quarter in Q2 while logic grew more slowly than Technoprobe. My fair value is about $133 against $149.15, and I leave the ladder at the forecasters' mean. FORM has no checked edge over the S&P 500 at this price, and the Q3 print (likely Oct 28) is the next real test.
key_drivers: Clean earnings power: the CFO's ~51% baseline GM at Q2 volumes. The Q3 54% guide includes $7-9M (~300bp) of IEEPA refunds, and Q2's 53.3% also had refunds plus Baldwin Park metal reclaim. The clean run rate is ~$0.77/quarter.

Farmers Branch: $25-30M of pre-production cost in 2026 is already inside non-GAAP opex. It moves into COGS from late Q4 FY26 and becomes GM-accretive from the beginning of 2028, a partial EPS tailwind inside the Oct-2027 NTM window.
Mix: DRAM/HBM +49% y/y but flat q/q in Q2; Foundry & Logic +22% y/y and +10% q/q, while Technoprobe grows +42% in logic. HBM share is strong at two of three makers.
Multiple: ~48x clean run-rate EPS today. The last peak-earnings top (2021) was ~32x realized forward EPS, so 30x NTM at Oct 2027 implies a roughly flat-to-lower price even with ~40% EPS growth.
Cyclicality: two ~61% drawdowns in five years and -49% within 2026. The Nvidia second source rests on one sell-side note (DB, 9/30); Nvidia was 10.2% of revenue in Q1 2026 only.
